summary: Alphabet Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for a proposed offering of multiple series of senior unsecured notes, including floating rate notes tied to Compounded SOFR and fixed-rate notes, all due in future years. The filing is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. Terms such as aggregate principal amounts, interest rates, and offering prices are left blank pending pricing. The notes will be structurally subordinated to subsidiary obligations and are not listed on any exchange. The filing is ordinary-course financing for the issuer.
